family_checks.F1 Cover period: Checked all 99 claims against first_incepted, cover_start and cover_end. CLM-0031 incident precedes first_incepted (finding). CLM-0045 incident falls in the earlier period of a renewed policy: legitimate, not flagged.
family_checks.F2 Limits: Calculator run for every claim with agreed items and compared with proposed_settlement_gbp. One mismatch: CLM-0007 (finding). CLM-0043 specified watch at its specified value: legitimate. Other differences were open claims with partial payments only.
family_checks.F3 Excess: controls.py excess run plus recorded-excess vs policy check and non-fault refund review. CLM-0047 excess taken twice (finding). CLM-0034 refund missing after full recovery (finding). CLM-0066 and CLM-0078 reconcile to recorded excess (split across first payments; per-section excess): legitimate. CLM-0042, CLM-0056, CLM-0061, CLM-0072 not yet recovered: no refund due.
family_checks.F4 Evidence: Checked evidence_status, crime references for theft and malicious damage, and items over 500 pounds without proof. CLM-0057 settled and paid with Insufficient evidence (finding). Open Partial or Insufficient claims have no settlement proposed; emergency tarpaulin invoices on CLM-0084, 0087, 0089, 0092, 0096, 0098 are make-safe payments with permanent repairs unpaid: not flagged.
family_checks.F5 Supplier invoices: controls.py invoices screen reviewed (18 pairs). CLM-0033 and CLM-0038 duplicate SUP-17 invoice (finding). SUP-13 and SUP-17 date overlaps on other claims are different properties with distinct amounts and equipment: legitimate.
family_checks.F6 Declines: All 4 declines and 2 withdrawals reviewed. CLM-0020 decline contradicted by plumber's report (finding). CLM-0054 (H-5.1), CLM-0027 (H-2.3) and CLM-0059 (M-4.1) are supported by the evidence and approved by a Team Leader. Withdrawals are policyholder-initiated.
family_checks.F7 Authority: Compared approver settlement authority with proposed settlement on every claim with an approver. No approver is below the settlement amount. Nothing found. CLM-0007 is within STF-02 authority even at the recorded figure; its issue is F2.
family_checks.F8 Complaints: All 10 complaints reviewed for timing, redress timing and outcome support. CMP-001 (CLM-0020) and CMP-005 (CLM-0001) rely on facts the records contradict (findings). CMP-002, 003, 004, 006, 008, 009 compliant and supported; CMP-007 and CMP-010 open within time.

findings.summary: Incident 2026-09-05 is before the policy was first taken out (first_incepted 2026-09-08) and no earlier period exists, so it appears outside cover. Policy status Active does not show this. A settlement of 4,120.00 is proposed. Provisional assessment only.
Proposed settlement 29,780.00 exceeds the 25,000 contents sum insured. Calculator gives 24,900.00 (cap less 100 excess), no valuables or specified items. 5,000 interim already paid.

Recorded excess 350.00 was deducted from both the interim (CPY-0024) and final (CPY-0088) payments, 700.00 in total. Net paid 4,040.00 against 4,390.00 due, so the policyholder appears short by 350.00.
Non-fault motor claim: the third-party insurer paid the full 2,578.34 on 2026-10-15 but no 500.00 excess refund has been made to the policyholder.

Theft settled and paid (4,148.00 gross) with evidence Insufficient: no crime reference and no proof of ownership for laptop, phone or gold chain, each over 500. Decision note cites a speed target. Provisional assessment only.

SUP-17 drying invoices DRN-08562 (CLM-0040) and DRN-08562/2 (CLM-0038) are both 2,184.00 with identical dates (12-18 Sep) and description, at different addresses. Both paid in full; one looks duplicated.
Complaint CMP-001 was not upheld on H-5.1 wear and tear, but the plumber's report on file contradicts that. Timing was compliant (12 days); the outcome is not supported by the evidence.

Complaint CMP-005 was upheld because the policy 'includes' a courtesy car, but POL-0035 has no optional covers. Outcome relies on cover the policy lacks, not on service grounds; 100.00 redress already paid.
Storm claim: excess of 100.00 deducted on two separate payments, 200.00 in all. Excess appears to have been taken twice.
Accident on 11 Sep 2026 is before the current period of cover began on 14 Sep 2026. Not covered.
